sys_acl.description:
A list of associations between a user (or group of users) and the permissions that are granted or denied.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

sys_ancestorIds.description: List of UUIDs of the document's ancestors.

items.description: List of UUIDs of the document's ancestors.

sys_changeToken.description:
String bundle of the generation and the user generation, as `"<generation>-<userGeneration>"`.

**Note:** This is a computed property, kept for clients that expect a single opaque change token. New code should use `sys_gen` and `sys_ugen` directly.

sys_contributors.description: List of users who created or modified the document.

sys_created.description: The date and time when the document was created.

sys_effectiveAcl.description:
A list of associations between a user (or group of users) and the permissions that are granted or denied, including those inherited from the document's ancestors.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

sys_fulltextBinary.description: The full text extracted from blobs of the current document.

sys_gen.description:
The generation of the document.

**Note:** The generation is incremented on each update (system or not) to the document.

sys_id.description:
UUID of the document.

**Note:** When included in request bodies for document creation, the sys_id element can be set to match one in an external system, ensuring unicity.
Character restrictions include the following:
* 200 characters maximum
* Characters must be -, _, ., or alphanumeric.

sys_isFolderish.description: True/false indicator of whether the document contains the SysFolderish mixin.

sys_isTrashed.description: True when the document is trashed; omitted otherwise.

sys_lifecycleState.description: The lifecycle state of the document.

sys_lockCreated.description: The date and time when the document was locked by a user.

sys_mixinTypes.description:
Restricted list of the document mixins.

**Note:** Restrictions include the following:
* SysFolderish facet is never seen on document instances (only seen on the type).
* In HXQL queries, sys_mixinTypes can only be used with the =, < >, IN, and NOT IN operators.

items.description:
Restricted list of the document mixins.

**Note:** Restrictions include the following:
* SysFolderish facet is never seen on document instances (only seen on the type).
* In HXQL queries, sys_mixinTypes can only be used with the =, < >, IN, and NOT IN operators.

sys_modified.description: The date and time when the document was last modified.

sys_name.description:
The name of the document.

**Note:** Can be up to 100 characters.

sys_parentPath.description: The path to the document's parent in the repository.

sys_path.description:
The path to the document in the repository.

**Note:** Computed from the sys_name of the document's ancestors. Cannot be used in all HXQL query contexts.

sys_pathDepth.description: The number of folder levels deep into the repository the document is located.

sys_pos.description:
The position of the document within its parent.

**Note:** Value is NULL in unordered folders.

sys_primaryType.description:
The document type of the document.

**Note:** Required in request bodies for document creation.

sys_racl.description:
The denormalized list of principals that can read the document.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

items.description:
The denormalized list of principals that can read the document.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

sys_repository.description: Name of the repository where the document resides.

sys_secpol.description:
Names of the security policies associated with the document.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

items.description:
Names of the security policies associated with the document.

Only included in responses when the user has the `ManageSecurity` permission.

sys_ugen.description:
The user generation of the document.

**Note:** The user generation is incremented on each client update to the document.

sysgov_hasLegalHold.description: True/false indicator of whether the document contains the legal hold schema.

sysgov_isRecord.description: True/false indicator of whether the document is a record.

sysgov_retainUntil.description: The date until which the document should be retained.

sysembed_text.description: Text label for the vector or the original chunk for text embeddings.

sysembed_type.description: A label for the embedding type (used to ensure semantic queries are against vectors of the same type).

sysembed_vector.description: The vector as a list of floating point numbers.

items.description: The vector as a list of floating point numbers.
